prompts.scenery:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a polished overhead retro arcade racing game.
Create one square image, exactly a regular 3 by 3 grid of NINE separate isolated roadside sprites, read left to right top to bottom. Equal cells, each sprite centered within its cell with generous fully transparent gutters and no objects crossing cells. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no roads or ground backgrounds.
Row 1: (1) a lush rounded broadleaf tree crown with detailed olive-green layered foliage and little sunlit leaves; (2) a compact flower-garden cluster of lavender, cream and coral wildflowers and leafy grasses; (3) a charming terracotta-roof countryside cottage with chimney, little porch and shrubs.
Row 2: (4) a graceful tropical palm tree with richly detailed radial fronds; (5) a small cream wooden sailboat with teal hull and warm linen sail; (6) a striped cream and coral beach parasol with two small wooden lounge chairs.
Row 3: (7) a small dense evergreen pine grove of three firs, dark teal-green needles and subtle warm sunlight; (8) a cluster of natural granite boulders, fine rocky facets and tiny moss and ferns; (9) a warm timber alpine cabin with pine-green roof, warm wood beams and a tiny stack of firewood.
All nine are in the same STRICTLY TOP DOWN / bird's-eye camera, facing north, designed to be drawn beside a vertically scrolling road. Painterly premium hand-painted diorama game art, meticulous edges and appealing readable silhouettes, softly rounded real materials, rich small-scale detail, natural soft light from upper left, restrained soft contact shadow down right. Cohesive palette of sage, olive, terracotta, ivory and teal. Not flat vector, not pixel art, not thick outlined cartoon, no heavy glow. Every object entirely inside its own cell. TRUE TRANSPARENT background and alpha around every isolated sprite, no baked checkerboard, no opaque background, no watermark. Square atlas.
prompts.items:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game pickup and hazard sprite atlas.
Create one square image, exactly a regular 2 by 2 grid of FOUR separate isolated sprites, with equal quadrants and transparent gutters. No grid, no text, no labels, no logos.
Top left: a delightful compact collectible rainbow FUEL SPORTS CAR, strict overhead top-down view, nose pointing directly to the top of image, slim vertical car proportions about 1 to 1.8. Beautiful candy-like painted metal panels with pastel coral, warm yellow, mint, turquoise and lavender rainbow bands, dark teal windshield, white highlights, distinct headlights and visible small black tyres. Highly readable reward object.
Top right: a hazardous glossy BLACK OIL PUDDLE, strict overhead view, wider than tall with an organic asymmetrical scalloped silhouette, deep ink-black centre, clear iridescent violet and turquoise petrol swirls, bright reflected edges. Oil only, no icon or background.
Bottom left: an elegant small golden amber metal FUEL CAN icon with teal handle and a subtle embossed fuel droplet symbol, soft shine and dark outline silhouette, viewed from overhead, useful as a dashboard pickup icon.
Bottom right: a thick rounded ivory-yellow WARNING TRIANGLE sign plate with amber outer border and a dark ink exclamation mark in its centre, front-on flat sign face, clearly readable at small size.
Cohesive premium hand-painted toy diorama arcade game style, intricate but clean, natural light from upper left, restrained down-right soft contact shadows. Objects isolated in their exact separate quadrant with 15 percent padding, no overlapping neighbouring cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT background and alpha around every sprite, no baked checkerboard, no opaque background, no frame, no watermark. Square atlas.
prompts.ground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted terrain texture atlas for an overhead scrolling racing game.
One square image, exact 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equally sized texture squares touching edge-to-edge, no borders or gutters. Each quadrant fills its entire square and must be individually seamless/tileable on ALL four of its edges.
Top left: softly variegated sage-olive meadow ground, delicate small grass blades and occasional tiny clover, low contrast, natural earthy green, no trees.
Top right: calm teal-blue ocean water seen straight from above, subtle turquoise currents, elegant fine ripple reflections and sparse tiny ivory foam flecks, no boats.
Bottom left: warm light cream golden coastal sand, delicate granular sandy texture, a few extremely tiny shell speckles, gentle dappled colour, no objects or footprints.
Bottom right: cool dark sage and muted teal alpine forest floor, subtle moss, earthy needle texture, delicate faded plant speckles, no trees, no rocks.
Premium intricate hand-painted game environment art, coherent natural soft illumination, richly textured but understated so foreground game props remain legible. Strict top-down flat orthographic terrain. No perspective, no roads, no vehicles, no large focal objects, no horizon, no text, no watermark. Opaque background. Each quadrant should have a uniform overall tone with seamless opposite edges, avoid a visible central highlight or borders.
